audio.text: I can't believe maintenance still hasn't fixed my heater.

options: Office hours are listed on the course syllabus.
I can't believe how fast this semester has gone by, honestly.
Yes, the heater was installed last year.
Have you tried calling them instead of using the form?

why.en: Complaint → a practical suggestion. A has nothing to do with the complaint; B repeats "can't believe" about something else; C says "Yes" and gives an irrelevant fact.
why.tr: Şikâyet → pratik bir öneri. A şikâyetle ilgisiz; B "can't believe" ifadesini başka bir konuda tekrar ediyor; C "Yes" diyor ve ilgisiz bir bilgi veriyor.
why.es: Queja → una sugerencia práctica. A no tiene relación con la queja; B repite "can't believe" sobre otra cosa; C dice "Yes" y da un dato que no viene al caso.
